name: team_planning_set_plan_value
description: Hold a person's level or FTE in a scenario of a Team Planning plan in place of the Org Graph's, for a value the HRIS has wrong or that is about to change. An FTE is above 0 and at most 1. The plan keeps the value private to that person, so once they are forgotten it reads as removed. Use team_planning_set_planned_level for a promotion. Refused unless the caller is one of the plan's editors.

scenario_id.description: The scenario, or the plan's id for the baseline.

value.description: A level, or an FTE such as "0.8".
